title: DecAthlete
overview:
Staking their claim to the title "King of Athletes," the decathletes dance in splendor!

- Eight athletes bursting with personality. Make the most of each one's specialty events and fight your way through all 10 events!
- Rapid button presses are everything! Timing decides the contest! Control your athlete just as you like with simple controls!
- Beautiful visuals using high-resolution mode. Polygons make immersive camera angles possible!

"キング・オブ・アスリード"の名をかけて、デカスリート達が華麗に舞う！

- 個性あふれる8人の選手たち。それぞれの得意種目を生かして全10種目を闘い抜こう！
- 連打が命！タイミングで勝負！簡単操作で選手を思い通りに操ろう！
- 高解像モードを使用した美しい画面。ポリゴンの使用で臨場感あふれるカメラアングルが可能に！
